# Rilla Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Six years old  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** Ingleside  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P3](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Rilla is a fat, roly-poly little girl with long, curly red hair and hazel eyes that button up in a funny, wrinkled way when she goes to sleep.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)_

## Personality

Rilla is proud, a bit prim, and takes pride in carrying out instructions given to her. She possesses a small soul that glories in fine clothing, though she can be easily terrified.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P12](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0012), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014)_

## Traits

- Proud  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000)</sub>
- Prim  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000)</sub>
- Vain  <sub>[v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P20](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0020)</sub>
- Fear of being hit with a dried codfish  <sub>[v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014)</sub>

## History

Rilla is the youngest of the Blythe children living at Ingleside. One day, Susan Baker dressed her in fine clothes and sent her with a basket of strawberries meant specifically for Mr. Meredith or Aunt Martha at the manse. On her way, she encountered Mary Vance, who attempted to take the basket from her. When Rilla stood firm and refused to hand it over, Mary terrorized her by chasing her down the Glen street while brandishing a large dried codfish. Rilla fled in panic, accidentally dropping and ruining the strawberries, before stumbling into a mud-puddle. She was picked up and brought home crying by Miss Cornelia Elliott.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P3](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0003), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P15](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0015), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)_
